Title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - March 30, 2026
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - March 30, 2026] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - March 30, 2026] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Game Modes:
  • Unranked Draft has been removed.
  Respawn Timers:
  • Respawn timers have been [Undocumented] ~~reduced in the mid-to-late game~~ updated .
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Unstoppable targets to not be immune to Blinds.

=== Battlegrounds: Garden of Terror ===
[Updates]
  General:
  • Garden of Terror Classic has been added to Custom Games!

=== Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Mines
    • Hero vision is reduced [Undocumented] from 12 to 6.5 while in the Mines.
  • Skulls
    • Objective is now complete when one team collects 55 Skulls, rather than when all 100 Skulls have been collected.
    • [Undocumented] Skulls dropped from Grave Golem increased by 10.

=== Battlegrounds: Warhead Junction ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Warheads
    • Cast time increased from 2.5 to 3 seconds.
    • Cast time now breaks upon taking damage.
    • Damage over time increased by 100%, [Undocumented] from 60 to 120 damage per second .
    • [Undocumented] Damage over time scaling increased by 100%, from 2.4 to 4.8 damage per minute.
    • Damage bonus to Forts, Keeps, [Undocumented] and Core increased from 100% to 125%.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Updates]
  Arthas has been fully reworked!:
  Stats:
  • [Undocumented] Maximum Health reduced from 2980 to 2625.
  • [Undocumented] Health Regeneration reduced from 6.207 to 5.4687.
  • [Undocumented] Attack Speed reduced from 1 to 0.91.
  Base:
  • Death Coil [Q]
    • Mana cost reduced from 50 to 40.
    • Healing reduced from 290 to 262.
    • [Undocumented] Range increased from 7 to 8.
  • Howling Blast [W]
    • Mana cost reduced from 60 to 50.
  • Frozen Tempest [E]
    • Mana cost increased from 11 to 13.
  • Frostmourne Hungers [D]
    • Cooldown increased from 10 to 12.
    • Damage reduced from 99 to 71.
    • Mana restoration increased from 30 to 40.
    • Additional functionality: Quest: Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage and Arthas's Basic Attack damage by 1.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • (Rework) Frost Presence
      • Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%.
      • Reward: After Rooting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path.
      • Reward: After Rooting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 0.75 seconds.
    • (New) Borean Winds
      • After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed [Undocumented] while it's active .
      • Frozen Tempest's Slow [Undocumented] and Attack Speed reduction last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.
    • Eternal Hunger
      • Removed.
    • Rime
      • Additional functionality: Arthas heals for 24 Health per second while Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.
  • Level 4
    • Shattered Armor
      • Moved from Level 13 to Level 4.
    • Frozen Wastes
      • Removed.
    • Frost Strike
      • Moved from Level 13 to Level 4.
      • Slow amount reduced from 50% to 20%.
      • Slow duration increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds.
      • [Undocumented] Even if not picked, Frostmourne Hungers applies a Slow.
      • Additional functionality: Frostmourne Hungers deals an additional 115 Spell damage in an area.
      • [Undocumented] Removed functionality: Death Coil no longer Silences for 1 second targets Slowed by Frost Strike.
  • Level 7
    • Immortal Coil
      • Healing bonus increased from 50% to 75%.
      • Additional functionality: Now also reduces Death Coil's cooldown by 3 seconds when self-cast.
    • Rune Tap
      • Healing bonus increased from 3% to 5%.
      • Additional functionality: Each stack of Frostmourne Hungers increases Arthas's maximum Health by 10.
    • Icebound Fortitude
      • Additional functionality: Each Hero [Undocumented] ~~Rooted~~ hit by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 2 seconds.
  • Level 10
    • (Rework) Army of the Dead [R1]
      • [Undocumented] Mana cost removed (previously 80).
      • Charge Cooldown: 18 seconds.
      • Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that last 15 seconds and attack for 20 damage. Ghouls can be sacrificed to heal Arthas for 240 Health. Stores up to 6 charges.
      • Every time an enemy Minion dies nearby, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.
      • Sacrifice
        • [Undocumented] Mana cost increased from 0 to 15.
  • Level 13
    • (Rework) Deathlord
      • Moved from Level 4 to Level 13.
      • If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.
      • Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.
    • (New) Deathchill
      • Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers.
      • Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% maximum Health.
    • Biting Cold
      • Damage bonus per stack increased from 12.5% to 15%.
      • Maximum damage bonus increased from 50% to 75%.
  • Level 16
    • Remorseless Winter
      • Activation time reduced from 3 to 2.5 seconds.
      • Internal cooldown reduced from 10 to 8 seconds.
      • Additional functionality: Now also heals Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health for each enemy Hero affected.
    • (Rework) Frostmourne Feeds
      • Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds.
      • Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.
    • Anti-Magic Shell
      • Moved from Level 20 to Level 16.
  • Level 20
    • (Rework) Legion of Northrend
      • Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.
      • Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.
    • Death's Advance
      • Removed.
    • (New) Death Pact
      • Instantly double your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, but it no longer gains stacks from hitting Heroes or killing Minions.
      • Takedowns grant 2 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers.
    • (New) Path of Frost
      • Activate to instantly mount with 10% additional Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds.
      • When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66 damage.
